description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a talented Data Engineer to join the Manufacturing Operations, Transportation Operations, and Reverse (MOTOR) organization in support of our Supply Chain Intelligence team. MOTOR manages the manufacturing of datacenter racks and the movement of racks/parts through the supply chain, consisting of transportation, warehousing, and reverse logistics into and out of the data centers. This role performs helps connect the different systems across the supply chain together so operational teams have clean, actionable data to work with. This requires someone with strong analytic skills and business acumen who can work with stakeholders on strategic projects across MOTOR.

The ideal candidate relishes working with large volumes of data, enjoys the challenge of highly complex technical contexts, and, above all else, is passionate about data and analytics. Must be an expert working with data modeling with un/structured data, ingestion pipelines and ETL design and business intelligence tools with the business to identify strategic opportunities where improvements in data infrastructure creates out-sized business impact. Candidate is a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to think big (while paying careful attention to detail), mentors other engineers in team on high quality tech, and enjoys working in a fast-paced team. Candidate will have a chance to architect the data pipelines needed for optimization and predictive analysis. We're excited to talk to those up to the challenge!



Key job responsibilities
- Build and maintain the infrastructure to answer questions with data, using software engineering best practices, data management fundamentals, data storage principles, recent advances in distributed systems, and operational excellence best practices. Build datasets that analysts and scientists use to generate actionable insights.
- Define the data engineering processes that leverage various AWS services to improve accessibility, redundancy, data integrity, cost, and storage requirements.
- Develop high quality solutions for the faster development of the products/models that solve the business needs in a scalable format, while also anticipating future requirements.
- Collaborate with Research/Applied Scientists, Data Engineers, Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Scientists, Business Analysts, and Product/Program Managers to understand the business and technical requirements, and make decisions that help make the products/programs smoother.
- Interface with other technology/data engineering teams to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of data sources using and AWS data technologies.
- Lead the technical design and implementation of the data infrastructure.
- Design and manage data audit, quality, and reconciliation processes in collaboration with various stakeholders.



About the team
This team provides data engineering and business intelligence engineering services to the rest of MOTOR. We are the data experts behind the scenes helping the operational teams focus on operations by ensuring they have accurate, timely data and provide business insights to help improve operational excellence.

*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

description:
Are you passionate about sustainability and waste reduction efforts across Amazon's global organization? Are you interested in building the data foundation that drives solutions balancing packaging and automation to increase speed, reduce cost, and ultimately delight our customers? The Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation team is looking for a Data Engineer to join us in building and maintaining the end-to-end data pipelines and infrastructure that power our analytics and business decisions. This is your opportunity to be a core part of the team that reduces waste for our business and our customers.

In this role, you will design, build, and operate the data pipelines behind our "source of truth" data store and metrics for warehouse automation and customer packaging. You will develop robust, scalable ETL/ELT solutions that integrate large, complex data spanning many sources and data structures using AWS tools, enabling data-driven decisions on OEE, machine metrics, and product performance across our packaging automation, IB sortation, and other warehouse automation products.

We are looking for a builder with deep SQL proficiency, strong Python skills, and knowledge of data modeling and warehousing best practices. You will apply rigorous data quality and data security practices, including validation, deduplication, PII handling, access controls, and monitoring, so that stakeholders can trust the data and sensitive operational data stays protected as it moves through our pipelines. You'll partner closely with Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Scientists, Product, and Operations to translate raw data into reliable, well-governed datasets and actionable insights.

The ideal candidate thrives amid ambiguity, builds for the future while delivering today, and understands the importance of code development best practices. If you love hard problems with many solutions and a diverse, results-oriented environment, come join us!



Key job responsibilities
• Be hands-on with ETL/ELT to build and maintain reliable, scalable data pipelines using SQL, Python, and Spark that support automated reporting for warehouse automation and customer packaging
• Interface with other technology teams to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of sources spanning warehouse automation and customer packaging
• Implement data structures using best practices in data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, SQL, and Redshift, and manage our "source of truth" data stores
• Implement best practices in batch and real-time data processing to make pipelines performant
• Apply strong data quality practices (validation, deduplication, PII handling, drift detection, and monitoring) so consumers can trust the data
• Build data security and access controls into the data infrastructure, protecting sensitive operational and performance data throughout its lifecycle
• Model data and metadata for ad-hoc and pre-built reporting, and deliver high-quality datasets to support BIEs, Data Scientists, and customer reporting needs
• Manage and optimize cloud computing resources on AWS to support data infrastructure
• Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Amazon Q, Kiro) to accelerate pipeline development, SQL, and debugging, while validating generated output for correctness
• Create extensible, easy-to-maintain designs with a long-term vision, laying groundwork to support future machine learning and GenAI use cases
• Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions


A day in the life
As a Data Engineer on this team, you will own the end-to-end data pipelines and infrastructure that serve as our "source of truth" for warehouse automation and customer packaging metrics. You will design, build, and operate robust and scalable ETL/ELT solutions, integrating complex data from dozens of sources to enable data-driven decisions across the Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation Organization.
You will partner closely with Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Operations teams to translate raw requirements into reliable and scalable data pipelines producing datasets that can be used and trusted across the org. You will also champion data quality and security practices, ensuring stakeholders can trust the data while sensitive operational information stays protected throughout its lifecycle.

description:
Amazon Prime's Member Experience organization leads Research & Development for Amazon Prime. The program serves over 300 million members across 25 countries and is key to Amazon's customer growth and engagement. We build algorithms and systems for automated marketing, personalization, targeting, and decisioning using Artificial Intelligence and Economics. Within the engineering group, we develop world-class solutions to complex scientific and engineering problems at Amazon scale. You will work alongside world-class scientists to build a suite of fully automated, scalable, and robust products driven by the data systems you develop.

As Prime expands its science-driven capabilities globally, we are growing the engineering team to meet increasing demand for reliable, high-throughput data infrastructure. Do you want to work with Amazon's best engineers on hard problems at massive scale? Do you want to impact over 300 million Prime members worldwide? Are you someone who likes using big data to drive high-impact business decisions? If so, come join our team!

Key job responsibilities
Build and maintain big data pipelines for machine learning applications at Amazon scale, ensuring stability and performance across terabyte-sized datasets
Advance data engineering infrastructure using tools such as AWS Glue, Spark, Amazon EMR, and EMR Serverless to support science and analytics workloads
Design and implement proactive data quality monitoring and alerting (e.g., anomaly detection) across production pipelines to safeguard downstream models
Collaborate with scientists and analysts to create coherent data models and analysis-ready datasets that improve the customer experience for over 300 million members worldwide
Evaluate and integrate generative AI tools where appropriate to automate data workflows and improve team productivity

A day in the life
You will collaborate closely with Prime business leaders, scientists (economists, research scientists, applied scientists), and engineering leaders to build data solutions. You will work with AWS technologies such as Amazon EMR, Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, and Amazon DynamoDB to process terabyte-scale data and support real-time access and orchestration across multiple systems. Your work will directly enhance scientific models and data applications that shape the Prime member experience globally. You will also participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team planning alongside both technical and business stakeholders.

About the team
The Prime Member Experience engineering team sits at the intersection of large-scale engineering systems and applied science ,econometrics, machine learning, and AI delivering applications that reach over 300 million customers. Our team includes data engineers, software engineers, and scientists who partner closely to build and operate real-time science products. We are focused on enabling Prime Science adoption worldwide across Amazon, and the growing complexity of our real-time data products creates data engineering challenges that give you hands-on experience with problems the broader industry will face in the years ahead.

description:
Description Amazon Live is building the future of shoppable video — connecting brands with customers through livestreams, short-form video, and creator-driven content across Amazon Shopping, Fire TV, Prime Video, and social platforms. The product serves millions of monthly viewers, processes billions of events daily across 9 marketplaces, and generates tens of millions of dollars in advertiser revenue, with a goal to reach 100MM+ MAUs and 20K+ brands in the next couple of years.

Amazon Live has a mature, high-performing data platform powering reporting across 9 marketplaces, 14+ dashboards, real-time creator analytics, and a growing suite of AI-native tooling (self-serve analytics agents, agentic operational assistants). The opportunity ahead is to build the next layer on that strong foundation: the team is standing up an intelligence layer — causal measurement, content intelligence, and ranking signals — and that requires a new class of foundational, reusable data assets purpose-built for both analytics and ML consumption. This role builds them.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join the DESA team as a dedicated owner of forward-looking data architecture. You will design and build durable, well-modeled datasets that serve three consumers at once: the BIE for executive reporting, the Applied Scientists for model training, and downstream ML systems (ranking, personalization, recommendations) for feature consumption. The goal is leverage — build an asset once, serve many use cases, and let the whole team move faster on top of it. Your work becomes the foundation the science function builds on: when the data assets are ready ahead of need, scientists model from day one instead of waiting on bespoke pipelines.

This is a high-ownership role on a team that moves fast. You will go from problem to production quickly, in a challenging and fast-paced environment, and you will work across the full breadth of the data domain — platform engineering, data modeling, ML-ready feature production, data quality, and AI-assisted development. You will partner closely with Applied Scientists, MLEs, fellow Data Engineers, and the BIE, giving you the opportunity to learn and execute across every aspect of a modern data organization — from raw event ingestion through the models and reporting that move multi-million-dollar business decisions.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build a content metadata layer that unifies broadcast events, product catalog data, creator profiles, and show metadata into reusable assets consumed by both dashboards and models.
- Build cross-session shopper profile datasets that sessionize event data across visits and compute rolling engagement metrics (frequency, recency, depth, conversion lag).
- Build integration pipelines connecting retail catalog and advertising performance data into the Amazon Live platform, unlocking new dimensions for analytics and ML.
- Produce structured, ML-ready datasets that feed Applied Scientists' models and serve features to downstream ranking and personalization systems.
- Own and advance data quality: proactive monitoring and anomaly detection so the team stays ahead of issues.
- Advance platform engineering maturity — CI/CD for ETL (BDT/Maestro), standardized deployment, and AI-assisted code generation and review.
- Partner with Applied Scientists, MLEs, DEs, and the BIE to align data assets to model, serving, and reporting needs.

A day in the life
You will move fast across a broad surface. Some weeks you will be designing a denormalized content metadata asset with an Applied Scientist to unblock a new model; other weeks you will be integrating a retail or advertising data source, hardening a pipeline's CI/CD, building data-quality alarms, or packaging features for the distribution team's ranking systems. You will partner daily with scientists, MLEs, DEs, and the BIE — scoping what to build and how it will be consumed — and you will have self-serve analytics agents and agentic operational tooling to accelerate your work (and a hand in extending that tooling as the platform grows). The pace is quick, the problems span the full data lifecycle, and the ownership is real.

About the team
The DESA team owns the data platform, analytics, and sciences for Amazon Live and Shop the Show. It is a compact, senior, high-trust team: DEs own the infrastructure and foundational data assets, the BIE owns executive reporting, Applied Scientists and MLEs own the models, experiments, and signals that turn data into product value, and everyone collaborates closely across those boundaries. As a Data Engineer here, you own forward-looking data architecture — the durable, reusable foundation the intelligence layer is built on — and you get exposure to the entire data domain, from event ingestion through production ML and leadership reporting. Your datasets become shared org infrastructure: the inputs to attribution models for partner teams, ranking features for distribution, and the reporting the business runs on.

Amazon's Global Media and Entertainment (GME) organization encompasses Prime Video, Amazon Music, Twitch, Audible, and Amazon Games businesses. The GME Finance team is establishing a Fintech team to build and operate systems that provide both financial reporting and operational analytic capabilities to GME Finance teams. We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to drive the team’s data strategy and vision. The data engineer will be responsible for design and build of the data infrastructure for automated and scalable platforms to support the reporting and forecasting requirements of GME finance teams. The data engineer will also lead and execute projects that build scalable data and visualization frameworks from multiple operational and financial datasets. The GME Finance team currently has a multi-year roadmap that aim to deliver automated reporting solutions, accelerate predictive forecasting, and interactive analytic tools for our finance analysts.

This role requires an individual with excellent data modeling, data architecture design, analytic visualization, ML modeling, and software development skills. A successful candidate will have the flexibility to execute on business intelligence projects while considering optimal and efficient data architecture. The candidate must have the ability to quickly build internal contacts and work across multiple finance, technology, product, and business teams to drive the overall strategy. This person will have the ability to Think Big about opportunities and challenges facing the business and the ability to influence the data and BI strategy through effective verbal and written communication, logical reasoning, and the presentation of alternatives.


Key job responsibilities
• Architect and develop end to end scalable data applications and data pipelines
• Design and build data reporting solutions across different visualization platforms (e.g. Quicksight)
• Establish scalable, efficient, automated processes for reporting, dashboards, data analyses and ML model development
• Ability to query, program, and perform analysis on large datasets using SQL languages and Python
• Build data infrastructure and manage other AWS resources including EC2, RDS, Redshift, EMR, etc.
• Collaborate with other teams to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of data sources using SQL and AWS big data technologies
• Participate in data strategy and road map exercises, data warehouse design and implementation
